name: ScrubInput
summary: The Studio inspector number: drag the label to scrub, type a value or an expression such as 12*2, or nudge with the arrow keys.
useWhen: A design property in an inspector panel: position, size, rotation, opacity, spacing
A value people tune by feel while they watch the canvas change
A field that must show one value for a multi selection, or say the values differ (mixed)
avoidWhen: A count or an amount in a form, where step buttons help more than a drag
A value on a known range picked by eye
Touch first screens, where a horizontal drag fights the page scroll

label.description: The scrub handle: a short letter (W, H, X) or an icon name. Hidden from assistive tech; the field is named by aria-label or the Field label.

value.description: The value, controlled. null is empty.

defaultValue.description: The first value, uncontrolled. Default empty.

onChange.description: Called with every committed value: each drag move, each nudge, a typed commit on Enter or blur.

step.description: One arrow key press and one pixel of drag. Shift is ten steps, Alt a tenth.

precision.description: Decimals the value keeps and shows.

unit.description: The unit shown after the value: px, %, deg. A typed value may carry this unit or none; another unit is refused.

mixed.description: The values of a selection differ: the field is empty and shows mixedLabel. Drag and arrows wait for a typed value.

mixedLabel.description: The word shown while mixed. Arabic: متعدد.

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28 and 32 px at default density. Inspectors use sm or xs.

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input; no scrub. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Readable and focusable; no scrub and no nudge. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

rootProps.description: Props for the root. className and style also go to the root; the ref and native input props go to the input.

a11y.role: textbox, from the native input. The scrub handle is aria-hidden: a pointer only shortcut for the arrow keys.
a11y.focus: The input is the only tab stop. A press on the handle with no move focuses the input and selects its text. Focus and a drag show the 2px ring.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the input, and on to the next control
keys.ArrowUp: Adds one step; with Shift ten steps, with Alt a tenth of a step
keys.ArrowDown: Takes away one step; with Shift ten steps, with Alt a tenth of a step
keys.Enter: Commits the typed value or expression, keeps focus and selects it
keys.Escape: Reverts the typed text; with nothing typed it goes on to the parent

a11y.announce: Name from aria-label or the Field label. The unit and the Field description and error through aria-describedby. Mixed reads as the placeholder.
notes: Every drag has a key path: the arrow keys move the same steps as the drag (WCAG 2.5.7).
A drag toward the inline end grows the value, so the drag direction flips in RTL. The ew-resize cursor points both ways and needs no flip.
Typing accepts arithmetic: + - * / and parentheses, the times and divide signs, Arabic Indic digits and the Arabic decimal mark. The value shows Western digits.
A typed text that is not arithmetic, or carries a unit other than the field's, goes back to the last value. It never becomes a zero.
Pass aria-label outside a Field: a letter such as W is not a name.

en.label: One letter or an icon for the handle: W, H, X, Y. The aria-label is the full noun: Width, Position X.
en.unit: The CSS unit or symbol: px, %, deg.

ar.label: حرف واحد أو أيقونة للمقبض، والاسم الكامل في aria-label: العرض، الطول

react.behavior: hand built, pointer capture for the scrub; logic in @the-system/shared scrub.ts and number.ts
react.note: Motion: none. The value follows the pointer with no animation; only the focus ring fades (an opacity transition).

styles.studio: A filled inspector rectangle (inspector.field.bg), no border at rest, the 2px ring on focus and while dragging
styles.desk: The same filled field on the Desk inspector fill

mistakes.wrong: A letter label as the only name of the field
mistakes.right: aria-label with the full noun, or a Field label

mistakes.wrong: A drag with no keyboard path
mistakes.right: The arrow keys on the input move the same steps

mistakes.wrong: A typed 5em in a px field kept as 5
mistakes.right: Refused and reverted: the unit must be the field's, or none

mistakes.wrong: Showing the first value of a multi selection
mistakes.right: mixed, so the field says the values differ

mistakes.wrong: ScrubInput in a checkout or a booking form
